+ import fs from "node:fs";
+ import { execSync } from "node:child_process";
+ import path from "node:path";
+ 
+ const basePath = path.resolve("scripts/data-import/processing/events");
+ const inputFile = path.join(basePath, "ufo-int-4.ts");
+ const jsonFile = path.join(basePath, "ufo-int-4.json");
+ const outputFile = path.join(basePath, "ufo-int-4-geocoded.json");
+ 
+ // Read the TypeScript file content
+ const fileContent = fs.readFileSync(inputFile, "utf8");
+ 
+ // Extract just the array parts to make valid JSON
+ console.log("Extracting UFO data from TypeScript file...");
+ 
+ // Regex to match the outer array structure
+ const arrayMatch = fileContent.match(
+ 	/const reports\s*=\s*(\[\s*\{[\s\S]*\}\s*\])/,
+ );
+ if (!arrayMatch) {
+ 	console.error("Failed to extract array data from the file");
+ 	process.exit(1);
+ }
+ 
+ // Extract just the array content and manually process it as text
+ const arrayContent = arrayMatch[1];
+ 
+ // Process the content line by line to extract valid records
+ console.log("Processing data and converting to valid JSON...");
+ const records = [];
+ 
+ // Use a simpler approach - split by record objects
+ const recordBlocks = arrayContent.split(/\},\s*\{/);
+ 
+ for (let i = 0; i &lt; recordBlocks.length; i++) {
+ 	let block = recordBlocks[i];
+ 
+ 	// Clean up the first and last blocks
+ 	if (i === 0) {
+ 		block = block.replace(/^\s*\[\s*\{\s*/, "{");
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	if (i === recordBlocks.length - 1) {
+ 		block = block.replace(/\s*\]\s*$/, "");
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	// Add the start/end braces if not the first/last
+ 	if (i &gt; 0) {
+ 		block = "{" + block;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	if (i &lt; recordBlocks.length - 1) {
+ 		block = block + "}";
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	try {
+ 		// Try to parse this block
+ 		const record = JSON.parse(block);
+ 		records.push(record);
+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		console.warn(&#96;Error parsing record ${i + 1}, will skip: ${error.message}&#96;);
+ 		// This approach skips problematic records
+ 	}
+ }
+ 
+ console.log(&#96;Successfully extracted ${records.length} records&#96;);
+ 
+ // Save the cleaned JSON data
+ fs.writeFileSync(jsonFile, JSON.stringify(records, null, 2), "utf8");
+ console.log(&#96;Saved cleaned data to ${jsonFile}&#96;);
+ 
+ // Now run the geocoding module on the cleaned JSON
+ console.log("Running geocoding on the data...");
+ try {
+ 	execSync(
+ 		&#96;node scripts/data-import/events/geocode-module.js ${jsonFile} ${outputFile}&#96;,
+ 		{ stdio: "inherit" },
+ 	);
+ 	console.log(&#96;Geocoding completed. Results saved to ${outputFile}&#96;);
+ } catch (error) {
+ 	console.error("Error during geocoding:", error.message);
+ }
+ 	console.error("Error during geocoding:", error.message);
+ }
+ 	console.error("Error during geocoding:", error.message);
+ }
+ 	console.error("Error during geocoding:", error.message);
+ }
+ 	console.error("Error during geocoding:", error.message);
+ }
+

+ import { execSync } from "node:child_process";
+ 
+ // File paths
+ const inputFile = "scripts/data-import/processing/events/ufo-int-4.ts";
+ const outputJsonFile =
+ 	"scripts/data-import/processing/events/ufo-int-4-fixed.json";
+ const geocodedFile =
+ 	"scripts/data-import/processing/events/ufo-int-4-geocoded.json";
+ 
+ console.log("Reading and cleaning UFO data...");
+ 
+ // Read the input file
+ const content = fs.readFileSync(inputFile, "utf8");
+ 
+ // Extract just the records manually
+ // This approach skips the JSON parsing and processes records individually
+ const lines = content.split("\n");
+ const records = [];
+ let currentRecord = null;
+ 
+ console.log("Processing records one by one...");
+ 
+ // Function to create a clean record entry with required fields
+ function createCleanRecord(name, date, description, location) {
+ 	return {
+ 		name: name || "Unknown UFO Event",
+ 		date: date || null,
+ 		description: description || "",
+ 		location: location || "Unknown",
+ 		latitude: null,
+ 		longitude: null,
+ 	};
+ }
+ 
+ // Go through the lines and manually extract the records
+ for (let i = 0; i &lt; lines.length; i++) {
+ 	const line = lines[i].trim();
+ 
+ 	// Start of a new record
+ 	if (line.startsWith("{")) {
+ 		currentRecord = createCleanRecord();
+ 	}
+ 	// End of a record
+ 	else if (line.startsWith("}")) {
+ 		if (currentRecord) {
+ 			records.push(currentRecord);
+ 			currentRecord = null;
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ 	// Record content - look for key fields
+ 	else if (currentRecord) {
+ 		// Extract fields we care about (for geocoding)
+ 		if (line.includes('"name":')) {
+ 			const match = line.match(/"name":\s*"(.+?)"/);
+ 			if (match) currentRecord.name = match[1];
+ 		} else if (line.includes('"date":')) {
+ 			const match = line.match(/"date":\s*"(.+?)"/);
+ 			if (match) currentRecord.date = match[1];
+ 		} else if (line.includes('"description":')) {
+ 			const match = line.match(/"description":\s*"(.+?)"/);
+ 			if (match) currentRecord.description = match[1];
+ 		} else if (line.includes('"location":')) {
+ 			const match = line.match(/"location":\s*"(.+?)"/);
+ 			if (match) currentRecord.location = match[1];
+ 		}
+ 		// Only pick up null or numeric values for lat/long
+ 		else if (line.includes('"latitude":')) {
+ 			const match = line.match(/"latitude":\s*(null|\d+(\.\d+)?)/);
+ 			if (match)
+ 				currentRecord.latitude =
+ 					match[1] === "null" ? null : Number.parseFloat(match[1]);
+ 		} else if (line.includes('"longitude":')) {
+ 			const match = line.match(/"longitude":\s*(null|-?\d+(\.\d+)?)/);
+ 			if (match)
+ 				currentRecord.longitude =
+ 					match[1] === "null" ? null : Number.parseFloat(match[1]);
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ }
+ 
+ console.log(&#96;Extracted ${records.length} records&#96;);
+ 
+ // Save the cleaned records as JSON
+ fs.writeFileSync(outputJsonFile, JSON.stringify(records, null, 2), "utf8");
+ console.log(&#96;Saved cleaned data to ${outputJsonFile}&#96;);
+ 
+ // Run the geocoding on the cleaned JSON
+ console.log("Running geocoding on clean data...");
+ try {
+ 	execSync(
+ 		&#96;node scripts/data-import/events/geocode-module.js ${outputJsonFile} ${geocodedFile}&#96;,
+ 		{ stdio: "inherit" },
+ 	);
+ 	console.log(&#96;Geocoding completed. Results saved to ${geocodedFile}&#96;);
+ } catch (error) {
+ 	console.error("Error running geocoding:", error.message);
+ }
+ 	console.error("Error running geocoding:", error.message);
+ }
+ 	console.error("Error running geocoding:", error.message);
+ }
+ 	console.error("Error running geocoding:", error.message);
+ }
+ 	console.error("Error running geocoding:", error.message);
+ }
